body.x: Greenzone Security will showcase its 'SmartLightweight IoT Security Platform' at CES 2019, the world's largest technologyexhibition in Las Vegas, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11 (Fri), 2019.

Greenzone Security began developing a "SmartLightweight IoT Security Platform" a year ago in the B2B market. Afterreviewing and investigating all of the security issues of the client, thecompany succeeded in constructing IoT security solutions through surveys andVOCs. The platform consists of three products: encryption technology, networksecurity protocol, and server solution. It provides perfect level of securitybetween devices and is effective for end-to-end security.

The 'smart lightweight IoT security platform'identifies hackers and blocks hackers using features such as encryption,authentication, security, communication channels and PKI. Greenzone Securityfocuses on customers who want to manage security SW policies for their B2Bcustomers, IoT devices, and use this platform to help users save money fromhacking losses and protect their privacy and data.
Greenzone Security plans to launch a B2B salesbusiness in the US by 2019.
